info.title: otra.city submission API
info.summary: List an AI tool or project in a free directory that is also a walkable city.
info.description:
One POST lists your project: a public listing page with a plain link to your site, and a shopfront the city builds on the road for your category. No account, no key, no human review.

The one rule that rejects most submissions: the page at `plot.url` must contain your permalink, `otra.city/s/<slug>`, as plain text or a link. Add it first, then POST with `"dry": true` to see the full report without publishing, then POST again without `dry`.

Full guide: https://otra.city/docs/submission.md. Machine-readable index: https://otra.city/llms.txt.

get.summary: What a submission needs: fields, rules, steps and an example body

post.description: Send `dry: true` first: nothing is published and the response carries a line-by-line `report` (PASS / FAIL / WARN) with what to change. Without `dry`, an accepted listing opens a pull request that merges itself within minutes; `pr_url` and `status_url` say where it is.

plot.name: My Tool
plot.description: One sentence about what it does and who it is for.

200.description: Accepted (published, or would be when dry)

422.description: Rejected: `report` lists every check and what to change

415.description: The body was not sent as application/json

get.summary: Whether a slug is free, pending or live, and where it stands

200.description: Status of the slug: exists, available, live, pending, position, lot_url, permalink

get.summary: Every road, every listing and every free lot

200.description: The street manifest: roads (with the categories each serves), lots, vacant

dry.description: true validates only; omit to publish

discovery_source.description: Optional: how you found otra.city. Logged, never published.

glb_base64.description: Optional: your own building instead of the city's shopfront (see docs/authoring.md)

glb_url.description: Optional: the same, fetched by url

slug.description: Becomes otra.city/s/<slug>, which must appear on the page at url

name.description: Goes on the sign over the door

url.description: https URL of your site; its page must contain otra.city/s/<slug>

description.description: Shown on your listing page; a tagline is derived from it

category.description: Decides which road you stand on. Unset means other; any other text is read as the nearest id, with a WARN in the report.

images.description: https png/jpg/webp: screenshots for the billboard and the wall inside

logo.description: https png, ideally transparent: built as a solid mark in the window

license.description: Your terms for visitors, shown and never enforced

report.description: Every check, one per line: PASS / FAIL / WARN, then VERDICT
